title: RX 7600 board VBIOS identity strings from the board's own Linux boot journal

board_runtime_corroboration.gpu_topology: SE 2, SH per SE 2, CU per SH 8, active_cu_number 32

provenance.capture_method: board boot journal lines quoted verbatim by the user; read-only

evidence_limits: This is a VBIOS IDENTITY STRING RECORD (name/version/date quoted by the amdgpu kernel driver), not a VBIOS byte dump. No ROM payload, VFCT, or ATOMBIOS image was captured.
The identity strings are user-maintained quotes from the board's own Linux boot; they are not cryptographically authenticated and provenance remains UNVERIFIED pending independent review.
The version string must not be treated as a GC IP revision; GC 11.0.2 comes only from the parsed IP Discovery artifact.
Do not infer register access, firmware loading rights, or macOS compatibility from this record.
